Chapter 7190: Not For Heaven To Decide

Chapter 7190: Not For Heaven To Decide

“Not for heaven to decide.” The new Duality Master opened his eyes and said softly.

“Boom!” The tribulations struck his body again.

However, the faith of all living beings granted him ultimate elasticity. Although the bolts pressed on, they couldn’t pierce through him.

His body stretched like a river of time before faint points of lights began to appear behind him. They formed a distant plane not part of this world - a net large enough to slow all the bolts from devastating Heavenrealm.

He was one with all living beings. As long as they had faith and confidence, he would not cease to exist.

“This...” Heavenfall had never seen anything like this before - how could living beings oppose the tribulations?

This was unprecedented and beyond his understanding. Meanwhile, spectators heaved a sigh of relief.

The defenders began to rebuild their body. Ninety percent had suffered grievous injuries and couldn’t recover fully. The collapsed wall saved them from total obliteration.

However, they didn’t know how long Duality Master could last. Therefore, they still had to keep trying.

“Buzz.” A temporal door appeared in the distant plane.

“The high heaven and all living beings on opposite sides, I have been waiting for this.” Someone walked out of the door.

This person’s existence disturbed time itself as if he didn’t belong here. He seemed to be made of flowing temporal light, having no sign of flesh and blood.

When looking at him, a mortal could see himself ten years or thirty years in the future. An immortal would see millions later, their last moment before falling to a tribulation...

“Genesis!” Hao Cai shouted.

Genesis was the lord of Heaven Assault Alliance and An Ran’s direct disciple. He disappeared long ago, rumored to have traveled to the future.

Hao Cai knew this rumor was true since he had joined Heaven Assault Alliance once.

“So pure and beautiful.” Genesis said: “Living beings as one, this is unprecedented.”

No one could disagree since they had no idea how Duality Master did it.

“I shall seize it now.” He laughed happily.

“He saw it in the future!” Hao Cai shouted, realizing why Genesis had returned.

“Bam!” A colossal machine appeared next to Genesis.

“Heavencrush!” Most immortals had seen it before - the mysterious machine of Heavenly Fortress World.

“All powers return!” Torrents of blazing temporal flames erupted from Genesis.

“Boom!” Epoch Dawn burst forth with light in resonation.

“Rise!” The essences from the great veins along with its inhabitants’ life force converged uncontrollably. This occurred in Heavenly Fortress as well.
